title: Mattel 2005 Hot Wheels First Editions Mitsubishi Eclipse Concept Car #002
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The Mattel 2005 Hot Wheels First Editions Mitsubishi Eclipse Concept Car #002 is a diecast toy vehicle modeled after the popular Mitsubishi Eclipse car. This 1:64 scale model is manufactured by Hot Wheels, featuring an orange color and suitable for both boys and girls. With an unspecified warranty length, this collectible item is part of the Hot Wheels First Editions series, making it a sought-after addition to any diecast and toy vehicle collection. Made in Malaysia in 2005, this Hot Wheels car is a great representation of the Mitsubishi Eclipse concept car.
